mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.token_version AS tokenVersion, u.status = 1 AS enabled, NULL AS loadedAt, NULL AS expiresAt FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status != 3
SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE status != 3
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET token_version = token_version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
